instruction:
Reconnect Supply Air System And Export Connectivity CSV

This task starts from /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and may use /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png as a local reference image. Modify the provided MEP model and save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv; /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv is not empty.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 3 IfcDuctSegment entities, 2 IfcDuctFitting entities, 2 IfcAirTerminal entities, 1 IfcDistributionSystem, 1 IfcRelAssignsToGroup relationship, 13 IfcDistributionPort entities, and 12 IfcRelConnectsPorts relationships.
4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcSpace, 0 IfcWall, 0 IfcSlab, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, and 0 IfcStair entities.
5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
6. The single IfcBuildingStorey is named exactly Ground Floor, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
7. The single IfcDistributionSystem is named exactly Supply Air, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and its single IfcRelAssignsToGroup relationship assigns exactly these 7 products: Bend Fitting, Branch Segment, Main Segment 1, Main Segment 2, Terminal East, Terminal North, and Transition Fitting.
8. Main Segment 1, Main Segment 2, and Branch Segment are IfcDuctSegment entities; Bend Fitting and Transition Fitting are IfcDuctFitting entities; Terminal East and Terminal North are IfcAirTerminal entities.
9. All listed products are spatially assigned to Ground Floor.
10. /home/user/Desktop/result.csv has exactly these headers in this order: GlobalId, Class, Name, SystemName, PortCount, ConnectedToCount.
11. /home/user/Desktop/result.csv has exactly 7 data rows, one row for each assigned product by matching GlobalId.
12. The CSV row for Bend Fitting has Class IfcDuctFitting, Name Bend Fitting, SystemName Supply Air, PortCount 2, and ConnectedToCount 4.
13. The CSV row for Branch Segment has Class IfcDuctSegment, Name Branch Segment, SystemName Supply Air, PortCount 2, and ConnectedToCount 4.
14. The CSV row for Main Segment 1 has Class IfcDuctSegment, Name Main Segment 1, SystemName Supply Air, PortCount 2, and ConnectedToCount 2.
15. The CSV row for Main Segment 2 has Class IfcDuctSegment, Name Main Segment 2, SystemName Supply Air, PortCount 2, and ConnectedToCount 4.
16. The CSV rows for Terminal East and Terminal North each have Class IfcAirTerminal, SystemName Supply Air, PortCount 1, and ConnectedToCount 2.
17. The CSV row for Transition Fitting has Class IfcDuctFitting, Name Transition Fitting, SystemName Supply Air, PortCount 3, and ConnectedToCount 6.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
